text: V1 for Haverbrook Tickets ships three things: real AWS infrastructure, one CI/CD pipeline, and real monitoring for catalog-api and checkout-api.
What V1 does not do: rewrite either service's own application code, including checkout-api's existing VoltPay integration -- that stays with Lin Chao's team.
V1 also doesn't add multi-region or disaster recovery -- that's a real idea, named and deferred as a future V2 initiative.
And V1 never touches VoltPay itself or Haverbrook's payment processing logic -- this project deploys and monitors the services that call it, nothing more.
Next: the first real architecture decision -- choosing the stack this infrastructure gets built on.
